goal: Run the ConstraintBox pipeline end to end from the repository checkout and record which model produced the proposal.
deliverable: One run receipt under the run directory, carrying the proposal gate reason codes and a model_resolved value recomputed from the provider's own session bytes.
out_of_scope: external simulation beyond the bound packet

assumptions.statement: The codex CLI is installed and authenticates from its own CODEX_HOME.
assumptions.source: measured on this host 2026-08-08 via which codex and codex --version

assumptions.statement: The five core tools import and respond in the project interpreter.
A gate identifier is admissible only with an execution receipt; a producer never sets its own ceiling.

evidence_required: a run receipt written to disk
model_resolved recomputed from bytes rather than from the requested slug
claim_boundary: This run evidences only that the pipeline executed and what the gate decided. It evidences nothing about the correctness of the proposal's content.
unknowns: whether the proposal will satisfy every field contract on the first attempt
communication_needs: report the disposition verbatim, including a refusal, without softening it
